objetos.descripcion: During its activation, the unit may use this item, consuming its action: choose an enemy unit within 6" or less, which suffers 1D6 direct damage (no save). Explosive (1). One grenade per unit, regardless of how many miniatures it has.
During its activation, the unit may use this item, consuming its action, to recover 3 lost Wounds.
When the unit is declared the target of an attack (ranged or melee), before any dice are rolled: it ignores all damage from that attack. If the attack had Explosive, there is no explosion.
Declare when attacking a Vehicle: that attack inflicts +2 to the total final bonus damage.
Declare when attacking a Hero: that attack inflicts +2 to the total final bonus damage.
Declare when attacking a Monster: that attack inflicts +2 to the total final bonus damage.
During its activation, the unit may use this item, consuming its action: it counts as in cover until the end of the turn.
When activated: +3" to its movement during that activation (also when Charging or Running).
When deployed: the unit deploys as if it had Vanguard (within 9" of an allied post).
If it suffers damage from an attack: reduce it by 1D3.
During its activation, the unit may use this item, consuming its action: all units within 3", allied and enemy, including those locked in combat, are returned to their nearest command posts.
